title: agrostemma triflorum
intro: Agrostemma triflorum, commonly known as Corn Cockle or Trifoliate Corn Cockle, is a plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and an antioxidant, helping to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Agrostemma triflorum include its potential to lower fever, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
